definition.meaning: The task names or inherits a prerequisite that has not emitted a current proof receipt.
definition.releaseEvent: owning dependency receipt changes and satisfies the prerequisite
definition.retryPolicy: do not retry until the dependency receipt checksum changes
definition.selection: exclude from implementation queue; keep in dependency review queue

blockerGroups.retryWhen: authorization receipt or target-list receipt changes

definition.meaning: The task would apply or promote a canonical mutation without an explicit current authorization receipt.
definition.releaseEvent: bounded authorization receipt and target-list checksum are present
definition.retryPolicy: do not retry on unchanged authorization state
definition.selection: exclude from implementation queue; allow only read-only preparation

blockerGroups.retryWhen: current packet materialization or digest receipt changes

definition.owner: canonical packet materialization and digest owner
definition.meaning: The selected source bridge is exact, but current packet rows or canonical packet content digests are incomplete.
definition.releaseEvent: packet materialization and independent digest readback become current for the admitted source cohort
definition.retryPolicy: do not retry until the packet identity/digest receipt checksum changes
definition.selection: exclude packet-dependent promotion; allow read-only writer and identity audits

definition.meaning: The task requires an admitted current source cohort, packet revision, or execution owner that is not proven.
definition.releaseEvent: current workspace/source/execution authority receipt changes to admitted and current
definition.retryPolicy: do not retry until the relevant authority receipt or revision changes
definition.selection: exclude live implementation; allow bounded audits that can produce the missing receipt

blockerGroups.retryWhen: current semantic snapshot and candidate-freeze receipts change

definition.meaning: The task depends on a lineage-qualified semantic snapshot and frozen CandidateOrdinal population.
definition.releaseEvent: semantic snapshot and candidate-freeze receipts both become current and lineage-qualified
definition.retryPolicy: do not retry until either required receipt checksum changes
definition.selection: exclude ANN/KMeans/SOM production work; allow fixture and read-only parity proofs
